fullPassage: Do you always study in the same spot? Don't. If you study in different places, that helps create variety, and that rich experience can reinforce what you are learning. When several college students told us they did school work in different places rather than in some favorite nook, that habit reflected the research on learning. Numerous experiments have found that if learners simply study in at least two different places, they are more likely to recall the material. In one of the first such trials, two different groups studied a list of words. Some students returned to the same room twice while their counterparts spent the same amount of time divided between two locations. When asked to recall as many words on the list as possible, those who had moved around did far better. Variety creates rich association, even when those connections form in the background, totally outside of what we are consciously thinking.

questions.passage: Do you always study in the same spot? Don't. If you study in different places, that helps create variety, and that rich experience can reinforce what you are learning. Numerous experiments have found that if learners simply study in at least two different places, they are more likely to recall the material. In one of the first such trials, two different groups studied a list of words. Some students returned to the same room twice while their counterparts spent the same amount of time divided between two locations. When asked to recall as many words on the list as possible, those who had moved around did far better. Variety creates rich association, even when <u>those connections form in the background</u>, totally outside of what we are consciously thinking.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 those connections form in the background가 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ those connections form in the background = 학습자가 인지하지 못하는 사이에 연상이 자동으로 만들어진다. 뒤이어 'totally outside of what we are consciously thinking'이 이를 부연한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 물리적 배경 각인(물리적 배경이 직접 각인된다): background는 물리적 배경이 아닌 의식의 뒤편이라는 비유

❌ ② 배경 지식 확장(배경 지식을 넓혀 준다): background knowledge가 아닌 의식 밖의 처리 과정

❌ ③ 의도적 연결 필요(의도적으로 연결해야 한다): 원문 반대 — totally outside of conscious thinking

✅ ④ 무의식적 자동 형성(의식하지 못하는 사이에 자동 형성): in the background + outside of conscious thinking ←정답
det.tip: in the background = 의식하지 못하는 사이에, 자동으로

ch: 학습 환경의 물리적 배경이 기억에 직접적으로 각인된다.
다양한 장소에서의 경험이 배경 지식을 넓혀 준다.
학습자가 의도적으로 장소와 내용을 연결해야 효과가 있다.
학습자가 의식하지 못하는 사이에 장소와 내용 간의 연상이 자동으로 형성된다.

det.korean: ② those who had moved around = 두 장소에 나누어 시간을 보낸 대조 그룹 학생들(counterparts). 앞 문장에서 counterparts가 두 장소에 나뉘어 공부했다고 언급.

❌ ④ 실험 설계자들(목록 작성한 설계자들): 본문에 등장하지 않는 대상
